Dan Sullivan against Dan Sullivan — How ridiculous is that? Thank you for your attention to this matter!" Trump posted to Truth Social on Monday night.

articles.title: Talarico warms to Trump, says he wants to help fulfill some MAGA promises
articles.summary: James Talarico told the "Diary of a CEO" podcast he'd work with Trump on healthcare, housing and childcare despite months of attacks from the president.
articles.body: James Talarico, the Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate in Texas, appeared to extend an olive branch to President Donald Trump in a podcast released Monday, expressing a willingness to work with Trump on a wide range of issues. "I would love, as the next U.S. senator from Texas, to work with Donald Trump to actually fulfill some of the promise of his political project," Talarico told Steve Bartlett, the host of "The Diary of a CEO" podcast. "The promise of MAGA was that we were going to transform this government so that it delivered for the people who have been left behind, the people who have been forgotten in this country. And there's still time to do that," Talarico continued. Talarico, who Trump has frequently mocked and criticized in the months leading up to the Texas state representative's crucial midterm contest against Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton, explained that he'd love to work with Trump on issues like healthcare and housing. "If the president wants to work with me or with any Democrat to expand healthcare access, I'm there. If he wants to make sure that every single kid in this country gets high-quality, accessible childcare, I'm there. If he wants to tackle the housing problem — Donald Trump is a builder — if he wants us to slash the red tape in this country so we could build millions of new homes and ensure everyone in this country has a place to call home, that I'm there. I'll work with him to do it. I would love to do that," Talarico said. BATTLEGROUND DEM TOUTS BIPARTISAN RECORD, BUT CAN’T NAME SINGLE ISSUE SHE’D WORK WITH TRUMP ON Talarico also indicated that a successful midterm election for Democrats could be a "rebirth" for Trump's presidency. "If the people of Texas, if the people of this country elect leaders who are going to check the president, I think it could be a rebirth for his presidency," Talarico said. SENATE CONTROL IS A COIN FLIP — AND DEMOCRATS’ PATH RUNS THROUGH TRUMP COUNTRY Talarico added that he hoped a Democratic victory Tuesday could be a "wake-up call" for Trump and his administration, claiming that he felt the administration should "reverse course" if faced with a Democratic supermajority in Congress. Talarico's willingness to reach across the aisle comes despite months of Trump badmouthing him on social media and the president campaigning in person for Paxton. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP Trump has taken to frequently referring to Talarico as "TalaFREAKo" in posts on Truth Social, calling him "unelectable" in Texas and disparagingly referring to him as a vegan, a charge which Talarico denies. Former White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt cast doubt on the authenticity of Talarico's intentions during a Tuesday morning appearance on "FOX & Friends." "I don't buy it for one second," Leavitt said. "This is exactly what the Democrats do in every election cycle. They are incredibly disingenuous. In fact, it's the one thing they are good at. They talk like the radical leftist that they are until they win their Democrat nomination. And then they try to fool voters by appearing moderate so that they can win their votes. But when they are elected, God forbid, if Talarico is elected, and we pray that he isn't after polls closed tonight, he will govern as a far left extreme liberal that he truly is," she continued. "Just listen to his own words. Some of the things he said in the past, he said he's a Christian who hates Christianity. He said God is non-binary. He said he believes there are six genders. He said that the United States southern border in the great state of Texas should be like a front porch where everybody is welcomed, while James Talarico, we have that for four years under the Biden administration, and it resulted in the worst border crisis in American history. He wants to abolish ICE. He wants to open our prisons. This is not somebody who is going to work with President Trump to secure our border and continue deporting illegal aliens," Leavitt added. "This is somebody who would join the ranks of the extremely liberal Democrat Party to engage in lawfare and obstructionism of all of the common sense policies that the Trump administration is continuing to pursue. And that's exactly why the great people of Texas need to get out and vote," Leavitt concluded. The Talarico campaign and the White House did not immediately respond to Fox News Digital's request for further comment.

articles.title: Pittsburgh, Allegheny County polling locations for Election Day 2026
articles.summary: Unsure about where to vote in and around Pittsburgh? Here's how to find your Allegheny County polling location.
articles.body:
Do you know where you're voting on Election Day ?

If you're not sure where to vote in the 2026 midterms , don't panic — with a few pieces of information about where in Allegheny County you live, the Pennsylvania State Department can tell you where to cast your ballot.

Allegheny County has numerous polling locations throughout the county. You can find your specific location through the Pennsylvania State Department by providing your county, city, street name, house number and zip code. Using that information, the website can direct you to your polling location.

What if I go to the wrong polling location?

You need to go to your specific polling location to vote. However, if you believe you're at the correct location, you may vote using a provisional ballot, according to the Pennsylvania State Department .

‘I voted’ stickers show unique election pride at midterm polls

Drop off sites for mail-in, absentee ballots

You can still return your mail-in and absentee ballots on Election Day between 7 a.m. and 8 p.m. These ballots can be returned at the County Office Building located at 542 Forbes Avenue, Pittsburgh.

Polling places opened at 7 a.m. and will close at 8 p.m.

Can I vote if I'm in line when polls close?

Yes, if you're in line by 8 p.m., you will be allowed to vote.

If you're a first-time voter in Allegheny County, you'll need to show your ID when you vote in person in Pennsylvania.

First-time voters should bring one current form of photo ID, such as their Pennsylvania driver's license or PennDOT ID card, an ID issued by any Commonwealth agency, and ID issued by the federal government, a U.S. passport, a U.S. Armed Forces ID, a student ID or an employee ID.

If you don't have a photo ID, you can use another document that has your name and address on it. These documents include confirmation issued by the county voter registration office, such as a voter registration card; non-photo ID issued by the Commonwealth; non-photo ID issued by the federal government; a firearm permit; a current utility bill; a current bank statement; a paycheck; or a government check.

Allegheny County will post the county's election results on their website . The state will post results on its website .

articles.title: Opposition parties demand re-enrolment for 27 lakh deleted voters in Bengal
articles.summary: Bengal opposition urges EC to let 27 lakh deleted voters re-enrol via Form 6, questions 16 lakh tribunal appeals and alleges mass deletions through Form 7.
articles.body: Kolkata: Opposition parties in Bengal on Tuesday demanded that 27 lakh voters whose names were deleted by judicial officers during SIR be allowed to apply for fresh enrolment through Form 6.Netas of Mamata Trinamool, Left Front and Congress alleged that EC was acting at BJP’s behest to facilitate the deletion of lakhs of names from the electoral rolls through Form 7.At an all-party meeting with CEO Neelam Meena, opposition netas also questioned the filing of 16 lakh appeals before the tribunal. They alleged that officials from the CEO’s office filed the appeals and sought the deletion of voters whose names judicial officers had already cleared.Mamata TMC’s Kunal Ghosh alleged that EC was imposing the SSR while SIR appeals were still pending. Ghosh said, “The voters whose names were deleted on the grounds of logical discrepancies should be allowed to fill Form 6 for re-enrolment.”“Special observer Subrata Gupta claimed that he had no information about filing 16 lakh appeals for exclusion. Then who filed those appeals? The CEO told us that it happened before she assumed charge. The CEO office has become a post office,” he alleged.Raising the issue of Form 7, CPM’s Palash Das asked, “Is this a project for mass deletion of voters in the interest of BJP?”Congress’s Ashutosh Chatterjee said, “Since Sept 21, tribunals could not upload their orders. The tribunal for Kolkata has no judge. Why? Who will bear responsibility?”In the meeting, BJP’s Sisir Bajoria pointed out that an elector in the Barabani assembly constituency was linked to 389 voters as their father. Similarly, in Bally, 310 voters linked an elector as their father.In a separate event, former Rajya Sabha MP Jawhar Sircar said, “We do not accept SIR. Civic polls should be held after including all eligible voters in the electoral roll.
